limitations: Coelicolor DesB catalysis is proposed and its physiological donor is not resolved; automatic FAD inference is qualified.
DesA direct evidence is abstract-limited;2018DesC full construct sequence differs from reported length and is not treated as exact.
2023DesABC cores differ from selected current proteins; their coupled preparation does not upgrade exact coelicolor assignments.
Terminal twoATP coefficient is a primary-supported net mechanism model; native oneATP equation also balances, so balance alone does not settle coupling.
Original DesD assay and native dimer facts are separate sources; physiological precursor pools and assemblies outside inspected preparations are unresolved.
